One number field of the wizard's forms

Source: R/wizard-national_rates.R
nr_field.Rd

Builds one labelled number field with the interface kit's cd_field_number(). The field checks what is typed against min and max, shows an error under the field for a value out of range, and sends only a valid value to the server. A required field that is empty shows a "not set" warning. A field whose hint is "hint_upload_percent" shows a "%" unit at its end.

Usage

nr_field(ns, i18n, inputId, labelKey, min, max, step, hintKey, required = TRUE)

Arguments

ns

The namespace function of the module the field belongs to (from NS(id) or session$ns).

i18n

The app's translator (a shiny.i18n translator), used for every label.

inputId

The input id of the field, without the namespace, a string.

labelKey

The translation key of the field's label, a string.

min, max

The smallest and largest value the field accepts, numbers.

step

The amount one step of the field changes the value by, a number.

hintKey

The translation key of the hint under the field, a string, or NULL for no hint.

required

TRUE (the default) when the field must have a value; an empty required field shows the "not set" warning.

Value

The field as Shiny tags.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# in a module's ui, where ns <- NS(id)
nr_field(ns, i18n, "anc4_prop", "title_upload_anc4_survey", 0, 100, 1, "hint_upload_percent")

# a field without a hint, which may be left empty
nr_field(ns, i18n, "survey_year", "title_upload_recent_survey_year", 2015, 2030, 1, NULL,
  required = FALSE
)

# from a field description of the app's wizard configuration
f <- cd_wizard_rate_field("stillbirth_rate", "sbr", "title_upload_stillbirth")
nr_field(ns, i18n, f$id, f$label_key, f$min, f$max, f$step, f$hint)
} # }
